events.name: First Friday Art Walk
events.place: Downtown Phoenix (Tap That Downtown, 909 N 5th St)
events.description: A neighborhood celebration with art, street vendors, live music, entertainment, food and craft beer. No cover.

events.name: Pickers Playground Vintage Market
events.description: Third-Sunday vintage shopping on a downtown plaza with 30 local vendors selling retro fashion, craft and art. Free admission.

events.name: Kermés PHX
events.description: Chinelos Unidos de Phoenix hosts Kermés PHX with vendors, food, drinks and dancing at Arizona Center. Free admission.

events.name: Portal Fest
events.place: S'edav Va'aki Museum, 4619 E Washington St
events.description: The 8th annual free family festival connects the community to the Ancient Sonoran Desert People and the traditions of O'odham and Piipaash artists. Activities and performances for all ages, with free museum admission all day.

events.name: Faire @ The Square
events.place: The Square PHX, 113 N Sixth St
events.description: A free family festival and winter artisan market with local vendors, crafts and lawn games, food, and demonstrations like guided sketching and a build-your-own bouquet bar. Rosson House Museum tours are $10.

events.name: PJs in the Park
events.place: Patriots Square at CityScape, 11 W. Washington St
events.note: Free 'Polar Express' screening and Santa photos.
events.description: Wear your coziest pajamas for a free outdoor screening of 'Shrek the Halls' and 'The Polar Express,' plus a free photo with Santa at 6 p.m. Hot cocoa and snacks are for sale.

events.name: APS Electric Light Parade
events.note: Free; arrive early for curb spots.
events.description: The City of Phoenix's 39th annual light parade, where families, neighborhood groups and businesses celebrate the season. The route runs from Central and Montebello to 7th St. and Indian School Rd.
know: Coolers OK; no alcohol or glass.

events.name: Tempe Festival of the Arts
events.description: One of the oldest festivals in the Southwest, with 350+ artists from around the country, local music, a Kids Block and food on historic Mill Avenue. Free admission.

events.name: Glendale Glitters
events.description: The 33rd annual display of holiday lights with interactive features, vendors, carolers and visits with Santa in downtown Glendale. The lights stay up through January 1.

events.name: Crossroads of the West Gun Show
events.place: Arizona State Fairgrounds, 1826 W. McDowell Rd
events.note: Kids 12 and under free with a parent.
events.description: A three-day Crossroads of the West gun show at the Arizona State Fairgrounds. One ticket is valid all three days, and kids 12 and under get in free with a parent or guardian.

events.name: Lost Dutchman Wildlife Guided Hike
events.place: Lost Dutchman State Park, 6109 N. Apache Trail, Apache Junction
events.description: Learn about the diverse wildlife of the Sonoran Desert on a guided hike with Arizona State Park volunteers at Lost Dutchman, beneath the Superstition Mountains.

events.name: Lost Dutchman Star Party
events.place: Lost Dutchman State Park, Apache Junction
events.description: Head to Lost Dutchman State Park for a monthly star party to learn about the stars and planets. Registration is required; check the park's event page for the time.

events.name: Taste of Korea Phoenix
events.place: Kingdom in the Valley Christian Church, 11640 N 19th Ave, Phoenix
events.description: An indoor celebration of Korean food, traditions and culture for all ages. Try Korean dishes (sold separately), cultural activities and traditional games.

events.name: PV Heroes & Hounds
events.place: The Park at PV, 12750 N Tatum Blvd, Phoenix
events.description: A community afternoon honoring Phoenix police, firefighters and their K9 partners. Watch K9 and search-and-rescue demos, tour fire trucks and SWAT vehicles, meet therapy dogs and enjoy family activities.

events.name: Phoenix Pizza Festival
events.place: Margaret T. Hance Park (east side), 1202 N 3rd St, Phoenix
events.note: Single-day admission; food and drink extra.
events.description: The 11th annual Phoenix Pizza Festival takes over Hance Park with pizza makers, local craft beer, live bands, lawn games and a kids' zone. Small leashed dogs under 25 lbs are welcome.
know: Admission doesn't include food or drink.

events.name: 2nd Sundays on Mill
events.description: 2nd Sundays on Mill at Mill Ave, Tempe. Free. Arizona time.

events.name: Phoenix Veterans Day Parade
events.place: 3rd St from McDowell Rd to Indian School Rd, Phoenix
events.description: Phoenix Veterans Day Parade at 3rd St from McDowell Rd to Indian School Rd, Phoenix. Free.

events.name: Merry Main Street Kickoff & Tree Lighting
events.description: Merry Main Street Kickoff & Tree Lighting at Downtown Mesa. Free.

events.name: Mesa Temple Christmas Lights
events.description: Mesa Temple Christmas Lights at Mesa Arizona Temple, 101 S LeSueur. Nightly. Free.

events.name: Chandler Tumbleweed Tree Lighting & Parade of Lights
events.description: Chandler Tumbleweed Tree Lighting & Parade of Lights at Downtown Chandler. Free.

events.name: Moon Valley Hanukkah Festival
events.description: Moon Valley Hanukkah Festival at Moon Valley Park, Phoenix. Free.

events.name: Downtown Tempe Menorah Lighting
events.description: Downtown Tempe Menorah Lighting at Downtown Tempe. Menorah lighting.

events.name: Fantasy of Lights Boat Parade
events.description: Fantasy of Lights Boat Parade at Tempe Beach Park. Free.

events.name: Family Fun WinterFest
events.description: Family Fun WinterFest at Arizona Boardwalk, Scottsdale. Free.

events.name: Arizona MLK March & Festival
events.description: Arizona MLK March & Festival at Eastlake Park, Phoenix. Free.

events.name: Queer Holiday Market
events.place: Chateau Luxe, 1175 E Lone Cactus Dr, Phoenix
events.note: Free indoor market of LGBTQ+ and allied makers, food and nonprofits. 4th annual.
events.description: The Greater Phoenix Equality Chamber of Commerce's free indoor Queer Holiday Market features LGBTQ+ and allied artists, makers, food vendors and community nonprofits at Chateau Luxe.

events.name: Phoestivus Holiday Market
events.note: Suggested $5 donation supports Downtown Phoenix Farmers Market. Dogs welcome.
events.description: Phoestivus is downtown Phoenix's outdoor holiday market with 170+ local vendors, food, live entertainment and festive activities. A fundraiser for the Downtown Phoenix Farmers Market.
